# Bitsmasher Lab

> Systems architecture, decentralized protocols, AI security engineering, and lab operations.

## Core Documentation & Manuals
- [/manual/index.html](/manual/index.html): Lab Operations Manual (Ansible, Kerberos, Kubernetes, DNS, Storage)
- [/manual/index.json](/manual/index.json): JSON Feed manifest of manual modules and PDF downloads
- [/manual/manual.md](/manual/manual.md): Full concatenated Markdown export of all 22 manual chapters for LLM ingestion
- [/manual/lab-manual.pdf](/manual/lab-manual.pdf): Master compiled operations manual (PDF, 64 pages)

## Training & Curriculum
- [/training/index.html](/training/index.html): Technical training curriculum, slide decks, and lab exercises
- [/training/index.json](/training/index.json): JSON Feed manifest of AI security, MCP, and prompt engineering modules
- [/training/docs/coding-foundations.html](/training/docs/coding-foundations.html): Systems and software engineering foundations syllabus
- [/training/docs/ai-security.html](/training/docs/ai-security.html): Enterprise AI security, threat modeling, and defensive operations syllabus

## Research
- [/research/index.html](/research/index.html): Systems and security engineering research blog
- [/research/index.json](/research/index.json): JSON Feed v1.1 research post archive
- [/research/about/index.html](/research/about/index.html): Research lab overview and methodology
